research_candidates.title: Anonymous Transactional Dataset
research_candidates.attribution: Engel, Gaol, Kurniawan and Budiharto; DOI 10.17632/kcgf45y24m.2
research_candidates.description: Indonesian F&B POS transactions from January–September 2025 and product metadata.
research_candidates.evaluation: Receipt/product identity and duplicate monetary fields need auditing. Digital method mapping, currency and local timezone need raw-file inspection.

research_candidates.title: Sandwich Analytics
research_candidates.description: US sandwich-location transactions and secondary weather/socioeconomic records for 2003–2013.
research_candidates.evaluation: Potential foreign sales/weather benchmark; digital payment evidence, file units, location timezone and leakage between related releases remain unverified.

research_candidates.title: Sandwich Analytics Part II
research_candidates.attribution: Spaulding, Laws, Davenport, Hassler and Cazier; DOI 10.17632/bfkvybtpj6.2
research_candidates.description: Menu-item receipt rows and associated weather for ten quickserve locations, April 2012–March 2013.
research_candidates.evaluation: Group line items by store and receipt before aggregation/splits. Check overlap with related releases. No digital-payment eligibility is established.

research_candidates.title: Café Data 2.0: New Data From a New and Improved Café
research_candidates.licence: supplemental data redistribution terms not verified; open article access alone is insufficient
research_candidates.description: Student-run US café POS records; the article describes 7,288 transactions and separate daily series.
research_candidates.evaluation: Article identifies cash, credit, debit and split tender. Use only verified digital credit/debit after inspecting originals; exclude mixed split tender without an explicit digital amount. Do not infer digital totals by subtracting reported cash totals.

rain.verification: legacy local copies; origin/licence and completeness require source-level verification
rain.warning: Sampled days are not a full daily archive. Missing is unknown, never zero. Official interval timing gate remains open.

psi.verification: legacy local summaries; do not assume complete hourly provenance or validated daily maximum

centres_closures.verification: representative/reference data, not merchant identity or verified historical closure versions

flood.verification: local reference document-derived list; not verified event labels

wbgt.verification: derived map only; full observed WBGT input archive missing

transactions.verification: supplied synthetic receipts only, no merchant connector or measured income-loss labels

normalization_gate: Do not relabel foreign data as Singapore hawkers, assume currency conversion, infer timezone/payment methods, or join synthetic centre IDs to real reference IDs without an explicit versioned mapping. No foreign source is approved for this adapter.
consented_singapore: No consented real merchant transaction dataset is available. Future source requires purpose-specific consent, retention/access controls and its own adapter.
